canonical_timestamp.metadata: randomTime * videoDuration; no re-adjustment or millisecond rounding
canonical_timestamp.missing_random_time: seedrandom/Alea first output; subtract 0.9 only when generated fraction exceeds 0.9
canonical_timestamp.official_time: true only for default branding endpoint

recovery.offscreen: pause transfer ticket and retry epoch; retain canonical request identity
recovery.terminal: invalid timestamp/image/options/data remain terminal; transient service/network failures deferred
recovery.cooldown_growth: Only exhausted service retry bursts, never ordinary visibility pauses
recovery.deferral_native_refresh: Only to restore an actual pending placeholder; otherwise scheduler state only

coalescing.cancellation: independent subscriber tickets; cancel network only after last ticket retires
coalescing.body: immutable response bytes shared without per-subscriber copies

request_key: Salted full URL hash, independent of video-ID validation

previous_release_live_issue.diagnosis: visibility pause -> native reload -> newly unloaded root -> pause loop
